items.html: And know that the phase of the tying of the vessels and their hold, as above, was by a coupling with which Aba coupled with Ima: Aba gave the drop of the male, and Ima gave the drop of the female, and through this the above-mentioned vessels, which were already in the world at the beginning, were tied, and they were corrected by them. And afterwards, the vessels are completed to be corrected in the twelve months of the pregnancy, as above. And they are seven vessels; we find that in every 51 and a half days, the vessel of one Sefira is corrected. And the phase of the lights: they are seven lights in seven months; we find that in every month one light is corrected.
